canvas_use_plan.decision: Use five component columns and a lower shared-memory row without introducing frames.

pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.placement_grammar: Role-tier columns with top-to-bottom progression inside the generation and knowledge stacks.
pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.card_sizing: Reserve icon and title space above supporting text; wrap sublabels at their existing font size.
pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.generation_path: Stack the three generation agents in their committed order, then hand off to the rendering column.
pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.refinement_loop: Separate the downward diagnosis connector from the curved upward correction connector.
pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.knowledge_feedback: Place memory below the component columns and use curved retrieval connectors with obstacle avoidance delegated to the renderer.
pattern_specific_layout_blueprint.output_alignment: Align the editable output with the render engine and reserve the upper corridor for their long-span connection.

boundary_derivation.node_bounds: Each card meets its upstream minimum dimensions and includes internal text clearance.
boundary_derivation.canvas_bounds: The union of node rectangles is [80,130,1520,870], entirely within the preferred viewport.

layout_self_audit.identity: The inherited role columns, shared memory, and refinement cycle preserve the architecture paradigm.
layout_self_audit.topology: All ten nodes and thirteen directed relationships retain their exact upstream IDs.
layout_self_audit.labels: No visible edge labels are emitted, so edge-label collisions do not arise.
layout_self_audit.separation: Node rectangles do not overlap; consecutive generation cards have 90 pixels of vertical clearance.
layout_self_audit.stacking: There are no group frames or standalone title elements.
layout_self_audit.ports: Every edge has two discrete endpoint objects selected independently from endpoint-center displacement.
layout_self_audit.routing: Feedback uses curves and offset handoffs use elbows; final obstacle avoidance and curve separation depend on renderer routing.
layout_self_audit.bounds: All node geometry uses integers and remains inside 1600 by 900.
layout_self_audit.styling: Inherited node styling is unchanged and every connector retains #21343A.
